hook: The phone rang 31 times during dinner rush
cta_sub: AI that books tables and answers questions by text

beats.say: Friday dinner rush. The phone rang thirty one times and nobody could pick up.
Every one of those was a table. A party of eight, a birthday, a catering order.
Luis, your kitchen is full. Your phone shouldn't be your bottleneck.
Who's talking? We're slammed in here.
I'm Jarvis. When a call goes unanswered, I text the caller back right away, so they don't just dial the place down the street.
I ask how many people, what day, and if it's a special occasion. Then I book the table and send a confirmation.
What about allergies? People always ask.
I note it on the reservation, and the kitchen sees it before they arrive.
I collect the date, headcount and menu, and send it to you as one clean summary. You just say yes.
Twenty two got a text back. Fourteen tables booked for tomorrow, and one catering order for fifty.
If your phone rings more than your staff can answer, DM the word BUILD, and Jarvis Works will set me up for your restaurant.
